body.text: DOMAIN POWER RENDEZVOUS. Repository evidence shows cmd/BonfyreLedger exists, but the reciprocal answer correctly says no verified Power-contract edge currently binds a named native Power to the finance projection. Do not fake that edge. Inspect the CURRENT worktree advertisements/Power registry and cmd/BonfyreLedger canonical ownership. If BonfyreLedger is still a live named native Power and its semantics lawfully intersect FinancialMetabolism, bind/expose it through the existing semantic-shell -> Operator ABI -> Fabric path without creating a second ledger or executor. Then prove a domain-specific round trip: semantic address -> named BonfyreLedger identity -> governed Fabric execution -> domain result -> ProcessOccurrence/authority receipt -> WHY/evidence. If BonfyreLedger is not the lawful owner for model-usage economics, explicitly prove why and select another existing domain-specific Power whose canonical contract can be exercised. The target is preservation of named Power identity, not forcing finance into the wrong command.

subject: Domain Power rendezvous: verify BonfyreLedger without inventing ownership
